fusions.name: Every Step Counted
fusions.desc: Stamps down, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health, and leaving them [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each stretch you have walked, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Unhurried Kick
fusions.desc: A kick that deals 12 damage, knocks the target 2.5 tiles back and leaves it [Bruised] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds. It moves 25% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Lungs
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 20 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Rest Stop
fusions.desc: When you have walked a long way, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
